$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema used to validate this registry config. Editors and tooling use it for autocomplete and validation.

name.title: Registry name
name.description: The unique name of the registry in the form "owner/registry". Used to identify and resolve this registry across the ecosystem.

description.title: Description
description.description: A short human-readable summary of what this registry contains and what it is for.
examples: The slim registry of Weme UI

version.title: Version
version.description: The version of this registry. Prefer a semver-compatible string so consumers can reason about upgrades.

homepage.title: Homepage
homepage.description: The URL of the project homepage for this registry.

repository.title: Repository
repository.description: The URL of the source code repository for this registry.

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: The URL of the issue tracker where people can report problems with this registry.

contributors.title: Contributors
contributors.description: A list of people who have contributed to this registry. Each entry is typically a name, optionally followed by an email address.

access.title: Access
access.description: Controls who can access this registry. "public" registries are open to everyone; "private" registries require authorization.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.description: Default runtime NPM packages installed into a consumer project when this registry is initialized. Unlike item-level dependencies, these apply once for the whole registry. Entries may include a version range or tag, e.g. "vue^3.4.0" or "lodash@latest".

devDependencies.title: Dev dependencies
devDependencies.description: Default development-only NPM packages installed into a consumer project when this registry is initialized. Use for tooling shared across the registry (e.g. test helpers), not for packages required at application runtime. Entries may include a version range or tag.

name.title: Name
name.description: The unique identifier of the registry item within its registry. Must be lowercase.

title.title: Display name
title.description: A human-friendly display name for the item, shown in UIs and documentation. Falls back to the name when omitted.

description.title: Description
description.description: A short summary of what this registry item provides, useful for discovery and documentation.
examples: A versatile button component with multiple variants.

type.title: Type
type.description: The category of this registry item. Defaults to "block" when omitted. Used for classification and to select the matching default install path.

when.title: Install timing
when.description: Controls when this item is installed during passive (automatic) installation. "on-init" installs as soon as the registry is initialized; "on-depended" installs only when another item depends on it. Explicit installs are unaffected.

type.title: Item type
type.description: The category of the registry item. Determines how the item is classified and which default install path it uses when resolving files.

kind.title: File kind
kind.description: The role of a file within a registry item. "file" is the primary source; "doc", "example", and "test" mark supporting documentation, demos, and tests respectively.

path.title: Source path
path.description: The path to the file within the registry package. Relative to the registry root.

target.title: Target path
target.description: The destination path where this file should be written when the item is installed. If omitted, the path is derived from the registry default paths and the item type.

items.title: Registry item file
items.description: Describes a single file that belongs to a registry item, including its source path, optional install target, type, and kind.

files.title: Files
files.description: The files that make up this registry item. At least the primary source files should be listed here.

cssVars.title: CSS variables
cssVars.description: CSS custom properties to inject when this item is installed. Values are merged into UnoCSS preset options, nested as theme-key → variable-name → value.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.description: NPM packages required at runtime by this item. Entries may include a version range or tag, e.g. "vue^3.0.0" or "lodash@latest".

devDependencies.title: Dev dependencies
devDependencies.description: NPM packages required only for developing or testing this item. These are not needed in production.

registryDependencies.title: Registry dependencies
registryDependencies.description: Other registry items that must be installed alongside this one. Referenced by item name within the same or a resolved registry.

meta.title: Metadata
meta.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata for tooling and documentation. Docs display fields use the "docs.*" namespace, e.g. "docs.category" and "docs.categoryLabel".

items.title: Registry item
items.description: A single installable unit in a registry. Describes identity, type, files, CSS variables, and both NPM and registry-level dependencies.

examples.name: button
examples.title: Button
examples.description: A versatile button component with multiple variants.

items.title: Items
items.description: The catalog of registry items published by this registry. Each item describes an installable unit such as a component, block, or utility.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: A list of registry item names to omit from resolution or installation. Useful for temporarily hiding unfinished or deprecated items.

anyOf.title: Item type
anyOf.description: The category of the registry item. Determines how the item is classified and which default install path it uses when resolving files.

defaultPaths.title: Paths
defaultPaths.description: Maps registry item types to install destinations. Use "*" as a catch-all for types without an explicit path. Paths may use aliases such as "~/components".

title: Registry configuration
description: Configuration for a Weme UI registry. Declares identity, access, default install paths, and the items the registry exposes.
